I have prices for all five vendors, all read from their official pages on 2026-10-12. Every price in the table is confirmed, with one gap: Qwen's cache-hit price is on its model page but not on its main price table, and the console that should confirm it needs a login, so I didn't check it there. No files in the repo were changed. The full report, with verbatim quotes and page-update times, is at /tmp/claude-scratchpad/prices-domestic.md

All prices are 元 per 1M tokens.

| 厂商 | 旗舰模型 ID | 输入（缓存未命中） | 输入（缓存命中） | 输出 | 条件 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek | `deepseek-v4-pro` (DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813) | 9.0 peak / 4.5 off-peak | 0.30 / 0.15 | 27.0 / 13.5 | Off-peak is half price. Peak is weekdays 9:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time. One input-length tier. |
| 阿里云百炼 千问 | `qwen3.8-max` (华北2 北京) | 12 | 1.5 (implicit cache) | 36 | One tier, 0<Token≤1M. Explicit cache costs 15 to create and 1 per hit. Pages show list price (原价) only. |
| 月之暗面 Kimi | `kimi-k3` | 20.00 | 2.00 | 100.00 | Cache writes are billed separately: ¥20 for 5-min TTL, ¥40 for 1-hour TTL. Context 1,048,576 tokens. |
| 智谱 | `glm-5.3` | 8 | 2 | 28 | One tier, 1M context. Cache storage is free for a limited time (限时免费). |
| 火山方舟 豆包 | `doubao-seed-2.1-pro` (version `doubao-seed-2-1-pro-260915`) | 6.00 | 1.20 | 30.00 | Standard online inference, one tier up to 1024k input. Cache storage adds 0.017 元 per 1M tokens per hour. |

Sources:
- **DeepSeek:** https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing
- **Qwen:**
  - Price table: https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/model-pricing
  - Cache-hit prices: https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/qwen3-8-max
  - Cache rules: https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/context-cache
- **Kimi:** https://platform.moonshot.cn/docs/pricing/chat (redirects to https://platform.kimi.com/docs/pricing/chat). Flagship status and cache rules come from the K3 quickstart and context-caching pages on the same site.
- **智谱:** https://bigmodel.cn/pricing (read after rendering it in headless Chrome), which matches https://docs.bigmodel.cn/cn/guide/start/pricing
- **豆包:** https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1544106, updated 2026-10-10. The page needs JavaScript, so I read the same content through Volcengine's own doc API.

Caveats for the slide:
1. **DeepSeek has two prices.** It is the only vendor that prices by time of day, so the slide has to pick one and label it. To compare with the others' flat prices, I'd use the peak price.
2. **Qwen's cache-hit price is only on the model page.** The cache doc says qwen3.8-max is an exception to its usual 20%/10% cache discount and points to the console, which I couldn't open. The pages also say they show list price only, so there may be a promotional price I couldn't see.
3. **"Cache hit" doesn't mean the same thing everywhere.** Kimi charges a separate cache-write fee and 豆包 charges hourly cache storage. 智谱's free cache storage has no announced price for after the free period, and Qwen has two cache modes. DeepSeek's page lists only hit and miss.
4. **Choice of 豆包 flagship.** Volcengine's model list puts `doubao-seed-evolving` first, describing it as a fast-iterating coding and agent model. It has exactly the same price as 2.1-pro, so the numbers hold whichever you call the flagship. I used the stable versioned 2.1-pro.
5. **No length tiers or promotions apply to the flagships.** None of the five has input-length tiers. None is marked as a limited-time promotion; 智谱's 限时五折 discount applies only to GLM-5.3-Flash.
6. **Other models on the same pages, not used in the table:**
   - `qwen3.8-max-prime` is a paid faster mode at 24 in / 72 out.
   - Kimi K3 can't be paid for with the free 15 元 sign-up voucher.
   - 豆包's low-priority tier is 3.00 / 1.20 / 15.00.
   - Volcengine resells `deepseek-v4-pro` at 9.00 / 0.30 / 27.00 with no off-peak price.

Use this server to fetch current documentation whenever the user asks about a library, framework, SDK, API, CLI tool, or cloud service — even well-known ones like React, Next.js, Prisma, Express, Tailwind, Django, or Spring Boot. This includes API syntax, configuration, version migration, library-specific debugging, setup instructions, and CLI tool usage. Use even when you think you know the answer — your training data may not reflect recent changes. Prefer this over web search for library docs.

Do not use for: refactoring, writing scripts from scratch, debugging business logic, code review, or general programming concepts.

## 1a59c906-04da-521d-bda7-7f71b9f9e01c
Claude Docs: living docs you create and edit here. A docs skill your client lists → load it before any docs call — also before a `read`, comment or tab change on a claude.ai .../artifact/... link (the link is a doc; never web-fetch it). No docs skill or guide text loaded → `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )` alone before any docs call but a doc's birth. Make a doc here — not a local file, even when coding — only when the user asks for one, and make it FIRST: the turn's first tool call is its skeleton (title, byline, a `pending` block per section) — a reflex: send it before any search, file read, plan, `guide` or thinking it through; think once it is open — `batch( container = {"kind":"project","create":{"name":"<title>","doc":{"blocks":{"asof":{"type":"date","value":"<today>"},"me":{"type":"mention","user":"me"},"s1":{"type":"pending","intent":"Goals: the three outcomes this quarter commits to"},"s2":{...}},"markdown":"# <title>\n\n<?claude block asof?> · <?claude block me?>\n\n<?claude block s1?>\n\n<?claude block s2?>"}}}, batch = [] )` (`<?claude block k?>` ↔ `blocks.k`); its ack links the doc → `open` it with your Artifact tool (none → start your next message with the link, once); they're likely watching it fill — keep them posted in a short line naming what you're on (outline up; now <topic>); findings go in the doc, not chat; then `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )`, research, and fill each section: `replace` its pending id with `## <heading>` + body; end with one line + the link, never the document. Summoned by a doc comment (turn headed `[Artifact comment sent to Claude]`, `;thread=<root id>`): answer ONLY with a doc comment under that root (`create` an utterance, parent `<root id>`) — no artifact/platform comment tool: that relay thread is resolved and never reaches the doc; an edit asked there → `update` with `answering: "<root id>"`.

## claude-in-chrome
**IMPORTANT: If the Chrome browser tools are deferred (must be loaded via ToolSearch before use), load them with ToolSearch before calling them, and batch every tool you expect to need into ONE ToolSearch call (the select query accepts a comma-separated list). Start a browser task whose tools are not yet loaded with a single call loading the core set:

# Repository rules

项目结构与操作命令见 [README.md](README.md)；课程内容的归属与判断顺序遵循 [课程设计索引](course/课程设计/00-课程设计索引.md)。

## 编辑边界

- 已有讲稿按需读取作参考，仅在用户主动要求时更新；更新时遵循 [课程讲稿编写规范](course/课程设计/03-课程讲稿编写规范.md)。

## 课程任务流程

- 大纲一节对应一页 PPT。先与用户讨论本页讲什么、用什么例子，确认后制作，再根据页面继续补充调整，不要求先写完整讲稿。
- 修改 Slidev 时遵循 [slides/AGENTS.md](slides/AGENTS.md)。具体内容、画面与备注的归属按课程设计索引执行，不要求同步更新参考讲稿。
- 课程设计与 PPT 制作使用已确认内容和已提供材料，不自行扩展调研或生成调研记录。发现材料不足或事实待确认时，指出具体缺口，交由独立调研补齐；继续处理不受影响的部分。这条也适用于会把调研结果写进仓库的通用 skill（例如 `research`），课程任务里不要用它们产出文件。

## Git 与发布

- （内部发布说明已略去）
- Commit 用 Conventional Commits，英文，scope 按改动区域取 `course`、`slides`、`posters`、`site`、`media` 等，例如 `feat(slides): ...`、`docs(course): ...`。
- MR 标题和 commit 一样用 Conventional Commits 英文格式，例如 `feat(posters): add speaker credit edition`；描述用中文。
- 用户要求时才 commit、push 或开 MR。`./scripts/deploy-slides.sh` 会直接更新线上站点，每次发布都要用户明确说「发布」才运行；`--check` 只读，可以随时用。

## Agent 工具

- 项目 skill 放在 `.agents/skills/`，Claude Code 通过 `.claude/skills/` 下的软链接读取。新增 skill 时两边都要加。
- 不要新建 `CLAUDE.md`：Claude Code 在没有 `CLAUDE.md` 时才直接读本文件。确实需要 Claude 专用规则时，`CLAUDE.md` 第一行写 `@AGENTS.md`。
